## Quarto

Quarto enables you to weave together content and executable code into a finished document. To learn more about Quarto see <https://quarto.org>.

## Running Code

When you click the **Render** button a document will be generated that includes both content and the output of embedded code. You can embed code like this:

```{r}
library(data.table)
library(MethylSeekR)
library(GenomicRanges)
library(tidyverse)
library(BSgenome.Hsapiens.UCSC.hg38)
```

You can add options to executable code like this

```{r}
#| echo: false
snpdb <- fread("/reference/dbsnp/150_hg38/All_20170710.vcf", skip = "#CHROM", select= c("#CHROM", "POS"))
snpdb_gr <- makeGRangesFromDataFrame(snpdb, ignore.strand = T, seqnames.field = "#CHROM", start.field = "POS", end.field = "POS")

methylome <- fread("/working/lab_olgak/lijunX/OV_meBRCA1_Nanopore/EpiRR/ENCFF889UGC.bed.gz") %>%
  mutate(M= round(V10 *V11 / 100, 0)) %>%
  dplyr::select(seqname = V1, POS = V2, `T` =V5, M) %>%
  makeGRangesFromDataFrame(., keep.extra.columns=T, ignore.strand = T, start.field = "POS", end.field = "POS")


meth.gr <- removeSNPs(methylome, snpdb_gr)

```
```{r}
sLengths = seqlengths(Hsapiens)
PMDsegments.gr <- segmentPMDs(m = meth.gr, chr.sel= "chr17", seqLengths = sLengths, num.cores = 1)

savePMDSegments(PMDs = PMDsegments.gr, GRangesFilename = "EpiRR_ovary_PMDs.gr.rds", TableFilename = "EpiRR_ovary_PMDs.gr.tab")




```

The `echo: false` option disables the printing of code (only output is displayed).
